detector.description: Alerts when k8s StatefulSet ready pods does not match desired pods for more than 95% of time in last 5 min
detector.name: K8s statefulset is not at spec for 5 min
detector.programText:
from signalfx.detectors.autodetect.infra.k8s import statefulset
statefulset.statefulset_pods_not_at_spec_detector().publish('K8s statefulset is not at spec for 5 min')

rules.description: The value of # (ready - desired) pods is outside of 0 and 0 for 95% of 5m.
rules.detectLabel: K8s statefulset is not at spec for 5 min
